data.name: DAIBADESTRUCTOR
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

DAIBADESTRUCTOR is a retro FPS in which you destroy a seafloor base near Odaiba, Tokyo. Make your way along the ocean floor crawling with all sorts of enemies as you wield both long-range and close-range weapons.

Synopsis...

Year 4078. Tokyo Bay's Odaiba district... The world has fallen under the rule of the evil secret society Touva. Humanity, along with most terrestrial life, has been culled by Touva's cyborgs. And yet, even as the world itself changed, the structures of power remained the same.

The cyborgs who rebelled against Touva—now a corrupt megacorporation—fled into an undersea base deep in Tokyo Bay, launching strikes to sabotage the company’s development projects. Enraged, Touva began abducting idle cyborgs, fitting them with explosive collars, and hurling them from Odaiba straight down into the seafloor base.

And just like any other day, another shrimp-like cyborg finds herself appointed to eviction duty, a live bomb fitted around her neck…

Features

・Easy to play!

Your main weapons are the nail gun in your left hand and the drill in your right. Use the correct weapons for the job, subduing any enemies that attack.

・Wide range of locations!

The seafloor base is a collection of illegally constructed buildings. Blast through cinemas, factories, submarine bases, undersea railways, and more to chase away the illegal squatters.

・Diverse and comical characters!

The seafloor base is home to mutants who possess marine creature powers. At times, you'll need to defeat them, and at others, befriend them and work together. Picking up ancient lifeforms along the way may also prove to be helpful...

・Outrageous stories!

With a bomb strapped around the protagonist's neck, she is fated to be blown up if she defies Touva Corp. But it seems there’s someone pulling the strings behind this chaos... Uncover the conspiracy and search for a way to remove the lethal collar as you make your way through the seafloor base.

data.short_description: Become a minion of a nefarious corporation and jump into the sea from Odaiba to destroy an underwater base in this easy-to-play retro-style FPS.
data.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese

content_descriptors.notes: Contains mild violence, such as depictions of blood.
